capabilities: Count words in the selected text of the active note
Post the count to a Beeminder goal via the 'Send word count to Beeminder' command
Configure Beeminder username, goal name, and auth token in plugin settings
extras: The README includes boilerplate release and manual-install instructions from the plugin template; it only counts the actively selected text, not the whole file, to avoid over-reporting when editing a file over multiple days.
motivation: The author only wants to report new words, not re-count edits to the same file across multiple days.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to report writing progress to a Beeminder commitment goal.

relations.evidence: This is a small plugin for Obsidian -> Beeminder word count integration.

summary: Beeminder integration that posts the word count of the selected text in the active note to a Beeminder goal via a command.
